title: Politeness Stereotypes and Attack Vectors: Gender Stereotypes in Japanese and Korean Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Masked language model probing using structured templates with varying verb politeness levels (e.g., rude, polite, formal, honorific) and locations to compare prediction probabilities of male, female, and gender-neutral pronouns. Additionally, measuring allocational bias by evaluating the performance (F1 scores) of cyberbullying detection models when toxic tweets are attacked/modified with different gender terms and politeness markers.
